title: fact_for picks a line that does not answer for 10 committed eval rows, skips fact lines that name a backticked file, and still picks table header rows
goal: bench_pool.fact_for picks, for each committed eval and near-miss row, a line that answers its question (BP-4f71647e: ansible/dsc3-module.md:18, not :19; BP-d306eaa8: mecm/cmpivot.md:14, not the permission line :49; and BP-34d1ec62, BP-78d6bbfe, BP-c552cb0f, BP-df64045a, BP-9cdc47a9, BP-6b791ed3, BP-8f566d80, BP-70d0bf39); POINTER skips a line only when it does nothing but point to another file (mecm/cmpivot.md:14, claude/hooks.md:148, windows/windows-update-management.md:14 and intune/ios-android-management.md:13 state facts); a markdown table header row and lines inside a code block are never picked. A plain rebuild still moves no committed row; a later --redo then asks the model about the right line. Found by the SP-7y6dk257 review.

run: import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','pool','build','--redo','BP-4f71647e','--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; print(o); sys.exit(0 if 'dsc3-module.md:18' in o else 1)

notes: Merged from BG-wamgfo7s “Two pool eval rows stay path-only: BP-005970a5's fact line answers neither part, and BP-2413ce41 needs a check no single regex gives” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Same class as BG-wcdbq563: committed pool rows whose check does not answer (fact_for picks :38 for BP-005970a5). Repro reproduces: both rows are path-only, 2 of 25 path-only pool rows in 130. No multi-part --replies feature is needed: hand-set a single-regex check (the LSASS GUID from asr-rules.csv:3; `Edm\.Boolean` for BP-2413ce41), which cached_checks keeps across rebuilds. Its goal: BP-005970a5 (which ASR rules support Warn mode, and the LSASS rule's GUID) and BP-2413ce41 (the type of the Graph beta device property isManagementRestricted) hold a check of the fact that answers them, not only an article path. BP-005970a5: fact_for picks defender/asr-and-antivirus.md:38 (rule groups), while :35 names the two rules without Warn mode and defender/asr-rules.csv:3 holds the GUID. BP-2413ce41: the answer is Edm.Boolean (graph/csdl-device.properties.csv:59); the model's bare Boolean is too broad for the guard, and pool build --replies reads only a row's first check, so a two-part check (the property and its type) cannot be given. Found in SP-7y6dk257 by ST-2p5ywkam's paid redo. Its touches: _tools/bench_pool.py, _tools/test_bench.py, kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv, kb/_self/tools.md
